Web Development

Web application built from scratch with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, Python and SQL as my Bachelor's thesis (Cursuri Studenți). Users upload course pages as images, which are converted to text and stored, so the materials can be reused in reports and projects. Users can edit their profile and add a logo to their account, while administrators manage both the user accounts and the course materials.
